record.question: Under the Central Civil Services (Classification, Control & Appeal) Rules, 1965 "Government servant" means a person who:
options: is a member of a Service or holds a civil post under the Union, and includes any such person on foreign service or whose services are temporarily placed at the disposal of a State Government, or a local or other authority
is a member of a Service or holds a civil post under a State Government and whose services are temporarily placed at the disposal of the Central Government
is in the service of a local or other authority and whose services are temporarily placed at the disposal of the Central Government
record.explanation: Cited PDF page and legal knowledge support this option.
